info.name: OPERA R&A Data Loader — OHIP GraphQL
info.description:
# OPERA R&A Data Loader — OHIP GraphQL API Test Collection

Covers all 6 data domains extracted by the OperaRADataLoader project:
1. **Auth** — OAuth2 token (OCIM)
2. **RES** — StatisticsReservationsDaily
3. **FIN** — FinancialTransactionDetails
4. **OTB** — StatisticsForecastSummary
5. **DIM** — FinancialTransactionCodes, RatesCodeDetails, InventoryRooms, ExportMappings
6. **RMN/OOO** — InventoryRooms, StatisticsManagersReport

## Setup
1. Import `OHIP-RA-DataLoader.postman_environment.json`
2. Fill in all `CHANGE_ME` values
3. Run **01 – Get OAuth Token** first — token auto-saves to `{{bearerToken}}`
4. Run remaining requests in order

## Field Verification
Use **Introspect — [SubjectArea]** requests to confirm exact GraphQL field names
against your live OHIP environment before implementation.

> GenAI-generated — reviewed and approved by: __________ __________

exec: // Global pre-request: add x-request-id to every request

request.description:
Obtains an OAuth2 bearer token using client_credentials grant.
Token is automatically stored in {{bearerToken}} collection variable.

Scope is always: urn:opc:hgbu:ws:_myscopes_

item.name: 01 – RES (StatisticsReservationsDaily)
item.description:
CSV: {RESORT}_OPERA_RES_{yyyymmdd}.csv
DB Table: RESERVATION_STAT_DAILY
Subject Area: StatisticsReservationsDaily

exec: console.warn('Token expired or missing — run 01-Get OAuth Token first');
console.warn('No data returned — check date range and hotel code');

body.raw:
{
  "query": "query StatisticsReservationsDaily($input: StatisticsReservationsDailyQueryArgumentsType!) {
  statisticsReservationsDaily(input: $input) {
    reservationDailyStatisticsDetails {
      businessDate
      resort
      resvNameId
      rateCode
      rateCategory
      marketCode
      sourceCode
      channel
      truncBeginDate
      truncEndDate
      room
      pseudoRoomYn
      roomCategoryLabel
      resvStatus
      quantity
      adults
      children
      stayRooms
      stayPersons
      stayAdults
      stayChildren
      arrRooms
      arrPersons
      depRooms
      depPersons
      dayUseRooms
      dayUsePersons
      houseUseYn
      complimentaryYn
      walkinYn
      noShowRooms
      noShowPersons
      cancellationDate
      country
      nights
    }
  }
}",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "reservationDailyStatisticsDetailsResort": { "_in": ["{{hotelCode}}"] },
      "reservationDailyStatisticsDetailsBusinessDate": {
        "_gte": "{{startDate}}",
        "_lte": "{{endDate}}"
      }
    }
  }
}

request.description:
Fetches daily reservation statistics.

**Key fields:**
- `resvNameId` — join key to FIN
- `roomCategoryLabel` — room type label (DB: ROOM_CATEGORY_LABEL)
- `stayRooms`, `arrRooms`, `depRooms` — occupancy counts

**Verify field names** via Introspect request if any field returns error.

Introspects the GraphQL schema for StatisticsReservationsDaily primary view.
Run this to confirm exact field names in your environment.
Field names printed to Postman Console.

item.name: 02 – FIN (FinancialTransactionDetails)
item.description:
CSV: {RESORT}_OPERA_FIN_{yyyymmdd}.csv
DB Table: FINANCIAL_TRANSACTIONS
Subject Area: FinancialTransactionDetails

request.description:
Fetches financial transactions for a business date range.

**Key fields:**
- `resvNameId` — join key to RES
- `ftSubtype` — C=Charge, FC=Payment, PK=Package
- `indRevenueGp` — Y/N revenue flag
- `tcGroup` / `tcSubgroup` / `trxCode` — transaction classification

**Late posting detection:** `trxDate > businessDate`

**Note:** COSTCENTER/ACCOUNT (BOF codes) not available in this SA — use ExportMappings SA.

item.name: 03 – OTB (StatisticsForecastSummary)
item.description:
CSV: {RESORT}_OPERA_OTB_{yyyymmdd}.csv
DB Table: RESERVATION_NAME
Subject Area: StatisticsForecastSummary
SnapshotDate = BusinessDate (set by loader). ConsideredDate = stayDate (future).

body.raw:
{
  "query": "query StatisticsForecastSummary($input: StatisticsForecastSummaryQueryArgumentsType!) {
  statisticsForecastSummary(input: $input) {
    forecastSummaryDetails {
      resort
      stayDate
      eventType
      roomCategoryLabel
      marketCode
      sourceCode
      rateCode
      rateCategory
      resvType
      dayUseYn
      arrRooms
      adults
      children
      depRooms
      noRooms
      arrPersons
      depPersons
      dayUseRooms
      dayUsePersons
      quantity
      nights
      resvStatus
      channel
      country
      currencyCode
      truncBeginDate
      truncEndDate
      grossRate
      netRoomRevenue
      extraRevenue
      roomRevenue
      roomRevenueTax
      foodRevenue
      foodRevenueTax
      otherRevenue
      otherRevenueTax
      totalRevenue
      totalRevenueTax
      nonRevenue
      nonRevenueTax
    }
  }
}",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "forecastSummaryDetailsResort": { "_in": ["{{hotelCode}}"] },
      "forecastSummaryDetailsStayDate": {
        "_gte": "{{otbStartDate}}",
        "_lte": "{{otbEndDate}}"
      }
    }
  }
}

request.description:
Fetches OTB (On The Books) forecast snapshot.

**Key mapping:**
- `stayDate` → CONSIDERED_DATE (future event date)
- `SNAPSHOT_DATE` is set by the loader to the current BusinessDate — NOT from API
- `roomRevenue`, `totalRevenue` — revenue on books

**Use {{otbStartDate}} / {{otbEndDate}}** for the future ConsideredDate range
(typically BusinessDate+1 to BusinessDate+365).

exec: if (rows) console.log('Pace rows:', rows.length, '— Sample:', JSON.stringify(rows[0]));

request.description:
Fetches Reservation Pace for a specific SnapshotDate.
Used for pace comparison — how many rooms were on books as of a past snapshot date.

`snapshotDate` = the historical date to compare FROM
`stayDate` = future stay dates to look at

item.name: 04 – DIM (Master Data)
item.description:
CSV: {RESORT}_OPERA_DIM_{yyyymmdd}.csv
Covers TC_CODE, TC_GROUP, ROOM_TYPE, RATE_CODE, CHANNEL, MARKETCODE, SOURCE_CODE

request.description:
Fetches transaction code master data.

**Key fields:**
- `trxCode` — TC_CODE
- `trxGroup` — TC_GROUP (ROOM, FB, PAY, TAX, PKG, MISC, etc.)
- `trxSubgroup` — TC_SUBGROUP (numeric subgroup codes)
- `revenueYn` — IND_REVENUE_GP equivalent
- `roomRevenueYn` — included in room revenue
- `packageYn` — included in package
- `activeYn` — active/deleted flag (N = deleted)

Fetches room configuration master data.
Group by `roomCategoryLabel` to get distinct ROOM_TYPE master list.

**Key fields:**
- `roomCategoryLabel` — ROOM_TYPE CODE (DB1, DS1, WB1, etc.)
- `roomCategoryDescription` — ROOM_TYPE DESCRIPTION
- `roomClass` — room class grouping
- `pseudoRoomYn` — N = physical room, Y = virtual/posting master

exec: if (rows) console.log('Rate codes:', rows.length, '— Sample:', JSON.stringify(rows[0]));

request.description:
Fetches rate code master data.

**Key fields:**
- `rateCode` — RATE_CODE
- `rateDescription` — description
- `rateCategory` — RATE_CATEGORY (RATE_HEADER in CSV)
- `rateClass` — rate class

Fetches MARKETCODE, SOURCE_CODE, CHANNEL dimension codes via ExportMappings SA.
These dimensions do not have dedicated master SAs — ExportMappings is the best source.

**Fallback:** Extract distinct values from StatisticsReservationsDaily if ExportMappings
does not return these field types in your environment.

**Key fields:**
- `fieldName` — FIELD_NAME (MARKETCODE, SOURCE_CODE, CHANNEL)
- `externalCode` — CODE
- `externalDescription` — DESCRIPTION
- `activeYn` — FLAG

item.name: 05 – RMN/OOO (Room Inventory)
item.description:
CSV: {RESORT}_OPERA_RMN_{yyyymmdd}.csv (room list)
     {RESORT}_OPERA_OOO_{yyyymmdd}.csv (daily OOO/OS counts)
DB Tables: ROOM, REP_MANAGER

request.description:
Fetches physical room list with current status.
CSV: {RESORT}_OPERA_RMN_{yyyymmdd}.csv

Room status values: CL=Clean, DI=Dirty, IP=Inspected, OO=Out of Order, OS=Out of Service
Filter `pseudoRoomYn = N` for physical rooms only.

item.name: OOO – Daily Room Inventory by Class (StatisticsManagersReport)

request.description:
Fetches daily OOO/OS room counts by room class.
CSV: {RESORT}_OPERA_OOO_{yyyymmdd}.csv
DB Table: REP_MANAGER

**Key fields:**
- `oooRooms` — OOO_ROOMS (out of order)
- `osRooms` — OS_ROOMS (out of service)
- `availRoom` — AVAIL_ROOM (available)
- `physicalBeds`, `oooBeds`, `osBeds` — bed-level counts

exec: if (rows) console.log('Inventory rows:', rows.length, '— Sample:', JSON.stringify(rows[0]));

request.description:
Fetches room-level OOO/OOS assignments by date range.
More granular than StatisticsManagersReport — provides per-room, per-date detail.

Use this to compute OOO/OOS counts by RoomCategoryLabel for ra.RoomInventory.

item.name: 06 – Blocks (BookingsBlock)
item.description:
Block reservations snapshot — combined into OTB export in the spec.
DB Table: Block header + grid
Subject Area: BookingsBlock

exec: const pastCutoff = rows.filter(r => r.cutoffDate && r.cutoffDate < today);

request.description:
Fetches group block reservations for a future date range.

**Key mapping to ra.BlockReservations:**
- `blockIdDate` → CONSIDERED_DATE (stay/grid date)
- `SNAPSHOT_DATE` set by loader (current BusinessDate)
- `blockedRooms` → ROOMS_CONTRACTED
- `pickedUpRooms` → ROOMS_PICKED_UP
- `remainingRooms` → ROOMS_REMAINING (may be computed)
- `cutoffDate` < SNAPSHOT_DATE → IS_PAST_CUTOFF = 1

Fetches property configuration.
Used to populate ra.Hotels master table.

**Key fields:** resort, resortName, country, currencyCode, timeZone, chainCode
